🇷🇺🇮🇳 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi on the sidelines of the SCO Summit (Bishkek, August 31, 2026).

💬 President Putin: I am very glad to meet with you again. 

This time, our meeting is taking place on the eve of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit – an organisation that works to deepen contacts among the countries of the Global South and East, promotes the region’s socioeconomic and cultural development, and contributes to building a just #MultipolarWorld.

🤝 I am also pleased to note that Russia-India relations continue to strengthen on the principles of a special and privileged strategic partnership.

Mr Prime Minister, this is undoubtedly facilitated by your personal attention to the development of Russia-India relations, as well as by the close personal friendship that has developed between us, for which I am very grateful to you.

Recently, Foreign Minister of India Subrahmanyam Jaishankar, during our meeting in Moscow, conveyed your message, and I fully share everything set out in it.

Next year, we will mark the 80th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations, and, of course, we are seriously preparing for the upcoming #BRICS Summit in New Delhi in September.

📈 Trade and economic cooperation is showing positive trends overall. There was a slight decline last year, but in the first half of 2026, trade turnover increased by 2.6%. A week ago, the Intergovernmental Commission met in Moscow and also reported good results.

I would also like to say a few words about humanitarian cooperation. India is among the leaders in terms of the number of students studying in Russia: over the past 10 years, their number has increased sevenfold and now stands at almost 40,000.

Cultural festivals are held regularly – both Indian culture festivals and Russian culture festivals. The next one is scheduled to take place in India in 2027.

Tourist exchanges are also developing rapidly, increasing by 16% in 2025.

🌐 We closely coordinate our efforts within the #UN, #BRICS, #G20 and, of course, the #SCO. Today, we have a very good opportunity to compare notes and chart the way forward in developing Russia-India relations.

#RussiaIndia #DruzhbaDosti

🇷🇺🇨🇳 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin during the meeting with President of China Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the SCO Summit (Bishkek, August 31, 2026).

💬 President Putin: I am sincerely glad to meet with you again – this time in Kyrgyzstan.

I would like to begin with the tragic events that recently occurred in China’s Tibet Autonomous Region, near the border with Nepal – a powerful mudslide struck the area, resulting in loss of life.

▪️ Please convey our deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives, as well as our wishes for a speedy recovery to all those injured.

***

We are meeting just a few hours before the start of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit. 

☝️ The SCO was established 25 years ago at the initiative of China and Russia. I am very pleased to note that our initiative has developed so successfully, acquired a truly broad international character and grown into a full-fledged international organisation.

This year we also marked the 25th anniversary of the fundamental Treaty of Good-Neighbourliness and Friendly Cooperation, signed by Comrade Jiang Zemin, who would have turned 100 on August 17. We remember his contribution to the development of Russia-China relations.

Today, amid a complex geopolitical environment, the comprehensive partnership and strategic interaction between Russia and China serve as a model of interstate relations.

🤝 They are founded on strong traditions of friendship, respect for sovereignty, equality and mutual benefit.

Cooperation is developing successfully across all areas, including the economy. We are implementing major projects in energy, industry, space, transport and logistics. The first regular voyage by a Chinese container ship along the Northern Sea Route took place in mid-August. Mutual agricultural trade is growing rapidly – up 34%.

Digital innovation, including artificial intelligence technologies, is opening up new opportunities for the economic development of our countries. Together with our Chinese friends, we established the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization in 2026. This was your initiative, which we were pleased to support, and we are committed to working together in this field.

Business and humanitarian contacts are undoubtedly facilitated by the 30-day visa-free regime. You announced this initiative a year ago, on September 2, during our meeting in Beijing. We supported it, and the arrangement is now in effect through the end of 2027. 

The results were immediate: tourist flows increased by 43% in the first half of 2026. We are ready to work together on making the visa-free regime permanent, should the Chinese Side consider this possible and beneficial.

🌐 As for current foreign policy issues, our fundamental approaches are close or fully aligned. In addition to the #SCO, we actively cooperate within the #UN, #BRICS, #G20 and ASEAN-centred formats, and, of course, we will continue supporting China’s chairmanship of #APEC.

#RussiaChina

The widely promoted Ukrainian Lima electronic warfare (EW) system, which was allegedly capable of disrupting even Kh-47M2 Kinzhal air-launched ballistic missiles, is now under investigation after authorities found that it failed to meet its declared specifications.

According to the investigation, Lima failed to demonstrate the claimed effectiveness against Geran loitering munitions. Between September 2023 and June 2024, LLC Okhrannoe Agentstvo KASKAD sold EW systems to Ukraine’s Ministry of Defense and critical infrastructure facilities for more than UAH 820 million, according to a ruling by the Kyiv Court of Appeal.

The cost of installing equipment to protect a single facility ranged from UAH 20 million to UAH 100 million. The systems were guaranteed to provide protection against Geran loitering munitions and Kalibr cruise missiles. It was also claimed that Lima had passed tests conducted by the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, demonstrated its effectiveness, and could be integrated with a centralized control point.

However, the investigation found that the reality was very different: Lima had never undergone the claimed tests, had not been used in combat, and the supposed centralized control point did not exist.

Further testing confirmed that Lima was incapable of countering the eight-element Controlled Reception Pattern Antenna (CRPA) Kometa used on Geran loitering munitions, let alone the 12- and 16-channel CRPA systems now deployed on Russian drones, guided aerial bombs, cruise missiles, and ballistic missiles.

This leaves us with two possible conclusions: either the Kinzhal’s warhead malfunctioned, or the video was AI-generated. After verification, the CCTV footage appears to be authentic, with no signs of AI generation or manipulation, reinforcing the first possibility, that the warhead simply malfunctioned.

🤝 В основе — прочные традиции дружбы, уважения суверенитета, равенства, взаимная выгода.

Успешно развивается сотрудничество по всем направлениям, в том числе и в экономике. Мы реализуем крупные проекты в энергетике, промышленности, в космосе, транспорте, логистике. Первый регулярный рейс китайского контейнеровоза был осуществлён в середине августа по Северному морскому пути. Высокими темпами растут взаимные поставки сельхозпродукции — плюс 34%.

Новые возможности для экономического развития наших стран открывают и цифровые инновации, в том числе и технологии искусственного интеллекта. Совместно с китайскими друзьями учредили в этом году Всемирную организацию сотрудничества по искусственному интеллекту. Это Ваша инициатива, мы её с удовольствием поддерживаем и нацелены на совместную работу в этом направлении.

Деловым и гуманитарным контактам, несомненно, способствует практика безвизового режима на 30 дней. Об этой инициативе Вы объявили год назад, как раз 2 сентября, на нашей встрече в Пекине. Мы её поддержали, и сейчас такой порядок действует до конца 2027 года. Результат не замедлил сказаться: турпоток увеличился за первое полугодие сразу на 43%. Готовы к совместной работе по переводу безвизового режима, если китайская сторона сочтёт это возможным и полезным, на постоянную основу. 

🌐 Что касается актуальных внешнеполитических вопросов, то наши принципиальные подходы близки или полностью совпадают. Помимо #ШОС мы активно работаем в #ООН, #БРИКС, #Г20, в асеаноцентричных форматах и, конечно, продолжим оказывать содействие китайскому председательству в форуме #АТЭС.

Благодарю Вас за внимание.
